name: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 V2 'Tephra'
story_html: The Yeezy Boost 700 V2 is the striking follow up to the Yeezy 700 which originally debuted at Kanye West's 2017 Yeezy Season 5 show. The V2 is more aerodynamic in appearance, with sleek, reflective overlays that draw the eye in. This rendition, the Yeezy Boost 700 V2 'Tephra' sneaker, features a mesh and suede upper with subdued natural tones, culminating in deeper hues on the midsole. This version reprises the 700's chunky sole, concealing full-length adidas Boost cushioning, underscored by gum-rubber tread.
